user_query: My friend is writing a research paper and needs to analyze the patent landscape. Fetch the patent numbers related to the research topic from the Stacks Patent Similarity API and analyze the patent descriptions. Also, check the spelling and grammar errors in the paper using the Bing Spell Check API.

TaskList.description: Fetch patent numbers related to the research topic using the Stacks Patent Similarity API.
Analyze the patent descriptions based on the patent numbers retrieved in step 1.
Check for spelling and grammar errors in the research paper using the Bing Spell Check API.
